text: The first Olympic Games of the modern era were held in which city in 1896?
explanation: The first Games of the Olympiad of the modern era were celebrated in Athens in 1896.

text: On which date was the International Olympic Committee constituted at the Paris Congress?
explanation: The IOC constituted itself on 23 June 1894 during the Paris Congress associated with the revival of the Olympic Games.

text: Under the Olympic Charter, an Olympiad is a period of how many consecutive calendar years?
options: Two years beginning with the Winter Games
Three years beginning after each Summer Games
Five years beginning with the host selection
explanation: The Charter defines an Olympiad as four consecutive calendar years, beginning on 1 January of the first year.

text: A question asks how Olympic Winter Games are numbered. Which rule gives the correct answer?
options: They are numbered consecutively in the order in which they are held
They are numbered by the four-year Olympiad in which they occur
They restart their numbering whenever a host continent changes
They use the same consecutive numbers as the Summer Games
explanation: Unlike the Games of the Olympiad, Olympic Winter Games are numbered consecutively according to the order in which they are held.

text: In the Olympic symbol, the five interlaced rings primarily represent which idea?
options: Union of continents and athlete meeting
Five sports in the first modern Games
explanation: The Olympic symbol expresses the union of the five continents and the meeting of athletes from throughout the world.

text: Which wording completes the current Olympic motto? “Faster, Higher, Stronger —”
explanation: The current Olympic motto is “Faster, Higher, Stronger — Together”, adding Together to the traditional three-word motto.

text: Which city is scheduled to host the 2028 Summer Olympic Games?
explanation: Los Angeles is the elected host of the 2028 Summer Olympic Games. Brisbane is scheduled for 2032.

text: According to the Olympic Charter, who owns the Olympic Games and the associated Olympic properties?
options: The organising committee of the host city
The National Olympic Committee of Greece
explanation: The Charter states that the Olympic Games are the exclusive property of the IOC, including rights relating to their organisation, broadcasting and use of Olympic properties.

text: Paris 2024 was which numbered Summer Olympic hosting occasion for Paris?
options: The first occasion since the modern Games began
explanation: Paris hosted the Summer Olympic Games in 1900, 1924 and again in 2024, making 2024 its third hosting occasion.

text: The 2026 Olympic Winter Games were held under which official host designation?
explanation: The 2026 Olympic Winter Games were the Milano–Cortina Games in Italy.

text: Who became India's first individual Olympic gold medallist?
explanation: Abhinav Bindra became India's first individual Olympic gold medallist by winning the men's 10-metre air rifle at Beijing 2008.

text: In which event did Abhinav Bindra win India's first individual Olympic gold medal?
explanation: Bindra won the men's 10 m air rifle gold at the Beijing 2008 Olympic Games.

text: Who won India's first Olympic gold medal in track and field?
explanation: Neeraj Chopra won India's first Olympic track-and-field gold in the men's javelin at Tokyo 2020, held in 2021.

text: Neeraj Chopra won India's first Olympic track-and-field gold in which event?
explanation: Chopra won the men's javelin throw at the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games.

text: How many medals did India win at the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games?
explanation: India won seven medals at Tokyo 2020: one gold, two silver and four bronze medals.

text: How many medals did India win at the Paris 2024 Olympic Games?
explanation: India's Paris 2024 tally was six medals: one silver and five bronze medals.

text: Which description correctly states India's Paris 2024 Olympic medal composition?
options: One gold, two silver and three bronze medals
Two silver and four bronze medals
One silver and five bronze medals
Two gold and four bronze medals
explanation: India won one silver medal and five bronze medals at Paris 2024, with no gold medal in the tally.

text: What medal did Neeraj Chopra win in the men's javelin at Paris 2024?
explanation: Neeraj Chopra won the silver medal in the men's javelin at Paris 2024; Pakistan's Arshad Nadeem won gold.

text: What notable Paris 2024 achievement did Manu Bhaker record for India?
options: First Indian woman with two Olympic medals
explanation: Manu Bhaker won two bronze medals at Paris 2024: in the women's 10 m air pistol and the mixed 10 m air pistol team event.

text: Which result did the Indian men's hockey team achieve at Paris 2024?
explanation: India won the men's hockey bronze medal at Paris 2024 by defeating Spain, successfully defending the bronze won at Tokyo 2020.

text: Which city hosted the inaugural Asian Games in 1951?
explanation: The first Asian Games were held in New Delhi, India, from 4 to 11 March 1951.

text: The first Asian Games were held in which year?
explanation: The inaugural Asian Games took place in New Delhi in 1951. The Asian Games Federation had been formed earlier, in 1949.

text: How many National Olympic Committees participated in the inaugural New Delhi 1951 Asian Games?
explanation: The official OCA record for New Delhi 1951 lists 11 participating NOCs.

text: Which statement about New Delhi 1982 is correct?
options: It was India's first Asian Games and the first under the OCA
It was the first Asian Games held outside Asia
It was the first edition to be held in two countries
It was the second Asian Games hosted by Delhi
explanation: New Delhi 1982 was the ninth Asian Games and the second edition hosted by Delhi, after the inaugural 1951 Games.

text: New Delhi 1982 was historically significant because it was the first Asian Games held under which organisation?
explanation: The 1982 Delhi Asian Games were the first held under the aegis of the Olympic Council of Asia; the first eight had been under the Asian Games Federation.

text: After the inaugural edition, the Asian Games were generally organised at what interval?
explanation: The OCA history records that, from the second Asian Games onward, the Games were organised once every four years, subject to exceptional postponements.

text: The 2018 Asian Games were hosted jointly by which Indonesian cities?
explanation: The 2018 Asian Games were held in Jakarta and Palembang, Indonesia.

text: Which city hosted the 2014 Asian Games?
explanation: The 17th Asian Games were held in Incheon, South Korea, in 2014.

text: Which city hosted the 15th Asian Games in 2006?
explanation: The 15th Asian Games were held in Doha, Qatar, in 2006.

text: The 11th Asian Games in 1990 were held in which city?
explanation: The 11th Asian Games were held in Beijing, China, in 1990.

subtopic: Current Asian Games cycle and Indian performance
text: Why may the most recent Asian Games be described as Hangzhou 2022 even though its competitions took place in 2023?
options: The host moved from Hangzhou to another city
The OCA renumbered the Games after closing
The Games were held twice, once in each year
The event was postponed from 2022 to 2023
explanation: The event retained the Hangzhou 2022 designation but was held from 23 September to 8 October 2023 after postponement. It was the 19th Asian Games.

subtopic: Current Asian Games cycle and Indian performance
text: What was India's total medal tally at the Hangzhou Asian Games?
explanation: India finished fourth at Hangzhou with 107 medals: 28 gold, 38 silver and 41 bronze.

subtopic: Current Asian Games cycle and Indian performance
text: Which medal combination correctly represents India's 107 medals at Hangzhou?
explanation: The official OCA medal table lists India's Hangzhou tally as 28 gold, 38 silver and 41 bronze medals.

subtopic: Current Asian Games cycle and Indian performance
text: Where did India finish in the Hangzhou Asian Games medal standings?
explanation: India ranked fourth in the Hangzhou medal table behind China, Japan and the Republic of Korea.

subtopic: Current Asian Games cycle and Indian performance
text: Aichi–Nagoya 2026 is which numbered edition of the Asian Games?
explanation: Aichi–Nagoya 2026 is the 20th Asian Games, following the 19th Games in Hangzhou.

subtopic: Current Asian Games cycle and Indian performance
text: What are the scheduled dates for the Aichi–Nagoya 2026 Asian Games?
explanation: The OCA lists the 20th Asian Games in Aichi–Nagoya for 19 September to 4 October 2026.

subtopic: Current Asian Games cycle and Indian performance
text: Which city is listed to host the 2030 Asian Games?
explanation: The OCA Games timeline lists Doha as the host city for the 2030 Asian Games and Riyadh for 2034.

subtopic: Current Asian Games cycle and Indian performance
text: Which city is listed to host the 2034 Asian Games?
explanation: The OCA Games timeline lists Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, as the host city for the 2034 Asian Games.

subtopic: Current Asian Games cycle and Indian performance
text: Which statement about India's Hangzhou 2023 performance is accurate?
options: India finished fourth with a record 107 medals, including 28 gold
India finished second with 70 medals, including 16 gold
India finished third with 111 medals, including 28 gold
India finished fifth with 96 medals, including 20 gold
explanation: India finished fourth at Hangzhou with 107 medals, including 28 gold. The 70-medal figure refers to India's 2018 Jakarta–Palembang tally, not Hangzhou.

subtopic: Current Asian Games cycle and Indian performance
text: Which e-sports statement was confirmed by the OCA for Aichi–Nagoya 2026?
options: The OCA removed all e-sports from the programme
Only Olympic sports could enter the programme
India alone selected every team-sport entry
The OCA announced 11 e-sports titles for the Games
explanation: The OCA announced 11 e-sports titles for the 2026 Asian Games; the event itself was scheduled for September–October 2026 as of the coverage date.
